# zombie-killer-tray

Windows-only local tray for conservative cleanup of orphaned MCP and language
server processes. Entrypoints: zombie_killer.py, zombie_tray.ps1 and
start-zombie-killer-admin.bat. No network access or telemetry. Mutation safety:
exact allowlist, two stable samples, dead-parent checks, minimum age, retained
Win32 process handle and pre-termination audit.
